legal.basis: 17 M.R.S. §1837-A — no registration where total prize value does not exceed $2,500 (any conductor) or $10,000 (eligible organization). Estimated total prize value here is roughly $320, an order of magnitude below the lower threshold.
legal.seller_age_rule: §1837-A(5): raffle tickets may not be SOLD BY a person under 18, except for raffles under subsections 2 and 3 designed to benefit children's activities at an event generally attended by persons under 18. This raffle plausibly falls in that exception — confirm before staffing the table with wrestlers.
legal.purchaser_age_rule: §1837-A imposes no minimum purchaser age for a paper raffle. The 18+ purchaser restriction in subsection 7 applies to INTERNET raffles only.
